schedule: Apply 50% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 50% Potassium as Basal dose at transplanting.
Apply 25% Nitrogen top-dressing at active tillering stage (3 weeks after transplanting).
Apply remaining 25% Nitrogen and 50% Potassium at panicle initiation stage (6 weeks after transplanting).
Apply 50% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 100% Potassium as Basal dose at sowing.
Apply 25% Nitrogen top-dressing at crown root initiation (CRI) stage (first irrigation).
Apply remaining 25% Nitrogen top-dressing at tillering/jointing stage (second irrigation).

organic_alternatives: Neem cake @ 100 kg/acre to reduce pest attack and nitrification rate
schedule: Apply 33% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 100% Potassium as Basal dose.
Apply 33% Nitrogen top-dressing at knee-high stage (4 weeks after sowing).
Apply remaining 34% Nitrogen top-dressing at tasseling/silking stage.
Apply 50% Nitrogen, 100% Phosphorus, and 100% Potassium as Basal application.
Apply remaining 50% Nitrogen as top-dressing at active vegetative growth stage.
